Chiikawa character reaction previews
===================================

These short audio files are unchanged public sound previews linked by the official LINE Store product page:
https://store.line.me/stickershop/product/37825/ja

Product: 『映画ちいかわ 人魚の島のひみつ』第２弾
Publisher shown by LINE Store: QTORY inc.
Copyright shown by LINE Store: ©nagano / 2026 Chiikawa the Movie Film Partners
Source page and preview metadata retrieved: 2026-10-20.

The gift website is an independent personal fan creation; it is not an official Chiikawa website or product. This provenance record identifies the source and does not establish or grant any reuse licence. Public preview availability is not a claim that the audio is public domain or royalty-free.

Only three short reaction previews were selected. No paid download, login, credential, region bypass or DRM bypass was used. The audio was not cloned, synthesized, pitch-shifted or otherwise edited. Temporary WAV copies were made outside the project only for attempted audio inspection.

Verification and limits
-----------------------
All three audio files were parsed with ffprobe and completely decoded with ffmpeg without error. All paired animated PNGs were visually matched to their official preview entries and parsed successfully: Chiikawa 11 frames; Hachiware 18 frames; Usagi 16 frames.

The execution environment could emit audio but the reviewing model did not support audio input. Therefore no claim of direct listening, exact spoken transcript, or auditory speaker verification is made here. Character association is based on the matching official sticker image and audio URL metadata. Browser playback should additionally be checked in the finished website.
